from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    patterns = []
    pattern_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            if c - start >= 2:
                seq = row[start:c]
                patterns.append(seq)
                pattern_cells.update((r, j) for j in range(start, c))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, color in enumerate(row):
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in pattern_cells:
                continue
            choices = [seq for seq in patterns if color in seq]
            if not choices:
                continue
            seq = choices[0]
            start = c - seq.index(color)
            for i, value in enumerate(seq):
                j = start + i
                if 0 <= j < w:
                    out[r][j] = value
    return out
'''
